notes:
Passed the fake-backend gate with exit code 0 (gate run 2, same digest as run 1). The card's GymnasiumDriver is used: the upstream QuadrotorEnv is a stable-baselines3 VecEnv whose reset returns the observation alone and whose step returns the legacy 4-tuple, which the Gymnasium bridge accepts. Not covered: the upstream simulator itself was never imported or run (the registered Quadrotor-v0 entry point needs constructor arguments that gymnasium.make does not supply), no hardware was attached, and the package is model-authored and unreviewed. The fake is a single-quadrotor kinematic stand-in for the default cmd_vel mode: it collapses the upstream num_envs batch axis, does not model the rigid-body dynamics, rotor thrust, motor model, wind, aerodynamics, rendering or the 4-value control modes, does not auto-reset on a terminal step, uses Python random instead of numpy/torch seeding, and has no snapshot/restore; all of these are in the fidelity gaps and the F0 claim. The upstream reset overwrites its options argument with self.reset_options (quadrotor_environments.py:285) while the fake honours it. Expected warnings from PLAYBOOK.md section 8: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only sets the next reset's seed) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived integer/numeric inputs (seed on reset and seed on seed, ticks, action.values). No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning. No operator-required limit and no site-limits.example.json; the only bound is the derived Box(-1, 1, shape=(3,)) action space.
